items.text: Rams listed WR Puka Nacua questionable (hip/groin soreness post-Thursday practice) for MNF vs Giants; will not practice Saturday; Whittington doubtful (quad). McVay: pre-game decision, unrelated to camp psoas.
items.why: Groin soreness after Thursday; DNP Fri/Sat; different from camp injury.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; ETR still prefers Puka side if healthy.
items.opportunity: If OUT, TE usage (Ferguson/Parkinson) + Konata Mumpfield or Malachi Fields bump; Adams full.

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring; previously doubtful on Friday reports. Ja'Kobi Lane also out-path.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Week 1 aggravated; limited practice Friday then downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; short-term absence expected.
items.opportunity: Targets funnel to Mark Andrews (25% share already) and remaining BAL WRs; BAL WR crumbs overall.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT Sunday with foot injury (was Q; LP-DNP-DNP).
items.why: Foot injury; limited then DNP progression.
items.implication: Sit; freer targets for DK Metcalf/others in PIT/NE game.
items.opportunity: PIT WR volume opens; Levitan flagged extended look at alternatives.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Sunday vs Bengals after mid-week practice injury; confirmed Friday/Saturday.
items.why: Grade 1 hamstring suffered in practice; DNP/limited then out.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz leads targets upside; Boutte/Hutchinson/Noel for WR volume.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow listed questionable (back) vs Texans but elevated Josh Johnson; reports and coach indicate expected to play/good to go after full Friday.
items.why: Back tightness; limited early week, full Friday; Burrow/Taylor adamant playing.
items.opportunity: Full CIN offense (Chase/Higgins/Brown) if active; Johnson is pure emergency.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers doubtful (knee) for Sunday vs Chargers; elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White. Will test pregame but doubtful tag rarely beaten.
items.why: Knee; limited Friday after procedure; coach to test.
items.implication: Plan without; low-end TE streaming or Mayer upside.
items.opportunity: Myarick elevation; Michael Mayer or other LV pass-catchers gain routes/targets.

items.text: Alvin Kamara expected/IN back; Travis Etienne Week 1 reduced workload (matched Miller rushes, air-heavy) now further squeezed in three-headed committee—Hate Etienne.
items.why: Kamara return + Etienne W1 usage concerns (Graziano intel); NO underdog script.
items.implication: Downgrade/fade Etienne to bench; Kamara cautious depth.
items.opportunity: Passing downs may tilt Kamara; early-down split Miller/Etienne.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury question on the slate; limited Friday after DNPs, Q vs Raiders (4pm ET). Affects Justin Herbert and entire LAC projections heavily.
items.why: Ribs from Week 1; DNP Wed/Thu, limited Fri; Harbaugh vague.
items.implication: Have pivot; ~44% play chance models; Herbert downgrade if out.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Quentin Johnston and other LAC WRs rise; LV secondary matchup.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN for 2026 debut; Patriots desperately need playmakers—do they give him 10+ touches vs Stevenson?
items.why: Cleared/IN on ETR board; NE offense needs juice post-AJ Brown IR.
items.implication: Monitor snap/touch share closely; potential flex/handcuff breakout.
items.opportunity: 10+ touch potential in committee with Stevenson; NE WR crumbs otherwise.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) status matters for SF backfield.
items.why: Strong W1 usage; Black Q/groin could consolidate more to CMC.
items.implication: Lock-in RB1; volume spike if Black limited/out.

items.text: Loves Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% route targets (team lead, 24% share), Indy just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite W1 utilization + soft IND run matchup; 10 Facts target share data.
items.implication: Start as strong RB1/2; massive season range of outcomes.

items.text: Loves Ashton Jeanty (99 util score W1, 19% tgt share recent) @ LAC and Bucky Irving (26% tgt, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell) vs CLE.
items.why: Utilization/target/RZ data from W1; favorable matchups.
items.implication: Strong starts; Jeanty overreaction fade, Irving volume locked.

items.text: Loves Justin Jefferson @ CHI (37% tgt from Wentz, career 18 PPG with him), Dak Prescott vs WAS (home smash, high total), Dalton Kincaid vs DET (69% routes career-high, top util).
items.why: Wentz volume history, matchup totals, route participation spike.
items.implication: Priority starts; Jefferson WR1, Dak QB1 spot, Kincaid TE upside.

items.text: Hates Marvin Harrison Jr. (8% tgt share W1, 0 RZ, tough SEA), Brian Thomas Jr. @ DEN (perimeter shutdown + shoulder), Harold Fannin (low 14% tgt/aDOT), and Etienne (Kamara squeeze).
items.why: Low target shares/utilization + tough matchups/injury limits.
items.opportunity: None positive; reverse for healthier alternatives.
